knowledgeAnswers.rationale: DRAFT - NEEDS EXPERT CHECK: Lesson TPL-02 instruction and common errors: add the cash buffer to the target, divide by contribution per job (after materials and travel), and round up. Dividing by job value is an error.

practicalCriteria: The personal costs, business costs and set-aside are each listed and totalled separately
Break-even jobs are calculated from contribution per job, with the calculation visible
The hours check includes non-billable hours and states whether the plan fits the hours available
A single decision is recorded with its reason and date, or a reason is recorded for making no change
passRule: assessor sign-off against rubric; no quiz pass
